items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: The INTERVIEWER mentions the Luscoe brothers and tells a story about them; the INTERVIEWEE (Mary Lou Williams) does not respond with any personal connection or confirmation of knowing them.

ctx.x: No, that isn't the - I've forgotten their name. The Luscoe brothers. They were pretty well to the point to, had to be careful. I remember once after playing they told the boys, "Let's go out and play softball." Whoever wins had to go back to the club and get a keg of beer. Naturally the boys won and the Luscoe brothers looked for them and they had gone home, because they were afraid to go back and pick up the beer.
While you were in Kansas City, musically did anything rub off on you? Did you have something that you were never doing before?
